note: Retrieval evaluation set. Each case is a question a user might ask of a source, plus terms that must appear in a genuinely relevant passage. `expect` is scored case-insensitively against the retrieved text; a case passes if a passage containing every term in any one of the `expect` groups appears within the top `k` results. Questions are deliberately phrased in the user's words rather than the document's, so the vector leg has to do real work.

cases.question: Why is it costly to make and enforce agreements between people?
How did economic institutions develop in early modern Europe?
Why do some societies fail to adopt institutions that would make them richer?
What role do institutions play in capturing the gains from trade?
